title.justification: The title clearly indicates that the paper deals with performative prediction, a framework involving predictions influencing data distributions, in the context of neural networks.
title.quote: Performative Prediction with Neural Networks Mehrnaz Mofakhami Mila, Université de Montréal

extractions.description: This paper discusses the framework of performative prediction with neural networks, where predictions made by models can influence the data distribution. The study focuses on finding classifiers that are performatively stable using neural networks, which are optimal for the data distribution they induce. The traditional assumptions of strong convexity and smoothness in the loss function regarding parameters are relaxed as the paper assumes the distribution is Lipschitz continuous with respect to predictions. The research includes introducing a resampling procedure modeling realistic distribution shifts and demonstrating the learning of performatively stable classifiers.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: While the research involves neural networks and prediction frameworks, which can have broader applications including sustainable development, the paper itself does not explicitly address climate or ecological sustainable development themes.
